On Thu, May 30, 2013 at 1:14 PM, Peter Hickey <peter....@gmail.com> wrote:

Hi all,

I've attached a plot I created manually using Illustrator that adds a horizontal boxplot to a lineplot. Basically, I'd like to be able to produce this type of plot using an R script in order to avoid the manual fiddling. 

Here are some example data; I can produce the lineplot and the boxplot separately but I can't figure out how to include the two on the same figure (if it is even possible using ggplot2).

library(ggplot2)

h <- data.frame(x = rpois(n = 200, lambda = 100), yint = 0)# yint is the y-value I'd like the boxplot to be centred around in the combined figure

d <- data.frame(x = 1:200, y = 1 - exp(-(rev(x))/100) + rnorm(200, 0, 0.05))

lineplot <- ggplot(d, aes(x = x, y = y)) + geom_line() + ylim(c(-1, 1))

hbox <- ggplot(h, aes(factor(yint), x)) + geom_boxplot() + coord_flip()


Can anyone please help me achieve this?

Thanks,

Pete

messages.subject: Re: Adding a horizontal boxplot to a lineplot
parts: Nevermind, I solved it by using geom_path() rather than geom_line. For reference, here is my solution:

library(ggplot2)
h <- data.frame(x = rpois(n = 200, lambda = 100), yint = 0)# yint is the y-value I'd like the boxplot to be centred around in the combined figure
ggplot() + geom_path(data=d, aes(x = y, y = x)) + geom_boxplot(data=h, aes(x=yint, y=x)) + coord_flip() + xlim(c(-1, 1))
